customManagers.description: Workflow tool pins — `version:` and `<tool>-version:` (e.g. setup-node's node-version) styles
Workflow/composite-action and script tool pins, `FOO_VERSION=x.y.z` shell-variable style

Per-architecture checksum pins, `*_sha256=<hex>` under a `# renovate: datasource=github-release-attachments ... digestVersion=<tag>` annotation, one annotated line per architecture. When the paired `*_VERSION` pin moves, Renovate bumps the tag and recomputes the hash of the same release asset in the same PR. digestVersion is the RAW release tag (v3.14.1, no extractVersion) because the datasource looks the release up by that exact tag.
Taskfile tool pins (root Taskfile + included taskfiles/), `FOO_VERSION: x.y.z` var style

Composite-action tool pins — a bare `version:` (setup-task) or a `<tool>-version:`/`<tool>_version:` input (setup-node, setup-tflint). The workflow manager above only looks at .github/workflows, so without this manager every pin in .github/actions/ is invisible to Renovate and silently frozen.

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before proposing any update
Batch all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
Batch regex-managed workflow and composite-action updates into one PR — the composite action provisions the same CI toolchain the workflows do, so its pins belong in the same batch

Give the checksum-pinned CI lint tools (shellcheck, shfmt, actionlint, yq, gitleaks) their own PR instead of the batched GitHub Actions group: their pins carry companion values (per-architecture hashes; for a formatter, what counts as correctly formatted), so one red lint-tool bump must not hold every Actions update back. Must come after the GitHub Actions grouping rules so this override wins.
prBodyNotes: Checksums move with their versions: every `*_sha256` pin carries a `github-release-attachments` annotation, so this PR should already contain the new hashes. If `task check` (scripts/test-tool-pin-pairs.sh) reports a hash left behind, retry this PR from the Dependency Dashboard rather than hand-editing the hash.
A formatter bump (shfmt) can change what `task check` accepts: run `task fix` and push the reformat as a separate commit; do not amend Renovate's commit.

packageRules.description: Eject anthropics/claude-code-action from the batched GitHub Actions group and skip the 3-day release-age wait. It ships near-daily first-party releases, so grouping + minimumReleaseAge kept the whole Actions batch perpetually pending on the renovate/stability-days gate. Must come after the GitHub Actions group rules so this override wins.
Batch all Docker image updates into one PR
Keep Ubuntu pinned to 24.04 LTS for remote-bootstrap environment parity; digest updates only

Reason: Node 25 drops the bundled Corepack that the shared devcontainer image installer and the packageManager convention rely on, and a runtime major moves the runtime under the whole repository at once, so it must never ride along inside the batched GitHub Actions PR. Matches both extractions of the runtime: the annotated regex pins (custom.regex, datasource node-version) and setup-node's node-version input (github-actions manager, uses-with, datasource github-releases). The datasource matcher keeps out node Docker images, which the github-actions manager also extracts as depName node from a job container or service, and package.json engines.node and @types/node are not matched either: none of them is the runtime; Upstream: https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/51981; Remove when: the runtime moves to the next major deliberately, the shared image provisions pnpm without bundled Corepack, and the canary builds and checks pass on that major; Canary: https://github.com/evanharmon1/harmon-init
